verses.text: For the music director. To the tune "Do Not Destroy." A psalm of Asaph. A song. We thank you, God. We thank you, because you are near. People tell about the amazing things you have done.
God says, "When the time I have chosen comes, I will judge fairly.
When the earth and everyone who lives on it shake, I am the one who holds its pillars firm. Selah.
I said to proud people, 'Do not boast.' I said to the wicked, 'Do not show off your strength.
Do not raise your horns against heaven. Do not speak so stubbornly and proudly.'"
Honour does not come from the east or the west, or from the desert in the south.
It is God who judges. He brings one person down and lifts another up.
The LORD holds a cup in his hand, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours it out, and all the wicked of the earth drink it down to the very last drop.
But I will always tell about this. I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
God says, "I will break the strength of all the wicked, but the strength of good people will be lifted up."
